Add coverage for unchanged-value adoption; the new tests leave its file-writing behavior unspecified.

## Changes
The pull request adds an adoption mode that records existing keys and writes their incoming values. It also adds tests for adoption and replacement with differing values.

## Important

No existing or added test exercises this equality boundary; the adoption test uses differing values. — Regression coverage does not establish whether adopting an unchanged setting should preserve configuration bytes or deliberately rewrite them.
